process_discipline_notes: Repeated the same unsupported justification ('most of our clients prefer a quick move') twice without adding new information after the customer pushed back both times.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: So, okay, so if we reduce by a person that basically, you're saying we'll just add like an hour... the math isn't really mapping to me

coaching_note: When asked directly why the mover count changed, the rep never gave a concrete, defensible reason (crew efficiency, safety, item count) — needs a clear, data-backed answer ready for exactly this objection, since 'that's what most clients prefer' visibly didn't land.
